subject: who may record a dataset quality decision
rationale: The mechanism requires a reviewer name and a role and invents neither. Until a person is named, no decision can be recorded at all.
decision_owner: repository owner, naming a data owner

subject: the dataset a first decision would be about
rationale: The only dataset in this repository is the quarantined legacy build, which must never be promoted. WP-C05 has not produced a replacement, so there is nothing legitimate to decide about.

subject: whether a role check is required before recording
current_state: role is recorded but not checked
rationale: WP-23's production role assignment set is empty by design, so there is nothing to check a role against yet. Whether a decision may be recorded before that exists is a governance choice.

subject: what a rejection obliges
rationale: A rejection is recorded and moves nothing. Whether it should also close the build, require a new build key, or permit a later approval of the same report is not decided.
decision_owner: data owner, with the repository owner
